name: Castejón de las Armas (Spain)
description: Blue field with a stepped hoist part of yellow and red bars, charged at the centre with a yellow bow and arrow.
history: Municipal flag of Castejón de las Armas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stepped stripe of yellow and red bars along the hoist
bow and arrow at the centre
